previewNotice.title: D0 Technical Preview
previewNotice.description: Functional foundation verifying server health and the use case catalog. Interactive solo storytelling will follow in Delivery D1; audio narration (D3a) and multiplayer duo modes (D4) are scheduled for subsequent deliveries.

game.title: A story starts with you.
game.intro: Choose a world, make decisions and enjoy the unexpected. One turn, three possibilities – or an idea of your own.
game.playIntro: Earlier contributions stay unchanged. You choose the next twist.
game.pick: Where would you like to begin?
game.pickHelp: Ten scenarios, countless possibilities. All in solo mode.
game.limitHelp: Hard limit. Estimates in US dollars.
game.privacy: Your input is sent to Google Gemini to generate text. Do not enter private or sensitive information. Solo sessions remain in volatile server memory for up to two hours. Reloading or a server restart ends access. A library comes later.
game.costNote: Estimated using published standard pricing. If usage metadata is missing, the reserved maximum is charged. One start call and one combined AI call per turn; no automatic paid retries.
game.footer: Stories grow one turn at a time. Solo · D1

components.hint: Up to 600 characters. Submit with the button.

errors.provider_unavailable: Gemini is unavailable. Server configuration needs checking.
errors.provider_error: Gemini could not respond. Your previous story stays unchanged.
errors.invalid_response: The AI response was incomplete or invalid. No new story segment was saved.
errors.network: Connection interrupted. Retry checks the same request without duplicating a turn.
errors.timeout: The request took too long. Your story stays unchanged; retry to check the turn.

errors.context_limit: The story has reached this session’s context limit. Start a new story.
errors.turn_limit: This solo session has completed its 30 turns.
errors.pricing_expired: Pricing must be verified again before further calls.
